events.title: Repurchases of shares during week 43, 2026
events.text: Between 19 October and 23 October 2026 Attendo AB (LEI code 549300KEJDL2FNITUW65) (“Attendo”) has repurchased in total 150,000 own shares (ISIN: SE0007666110) as part of the repurchase program initiated by the Board. The repurchases form part of the repurchase program of a total maximum amount of SEK 250,000,000 that Attendo announced on 20 August 2026. The repurchase program, which runs between 27 August 2026 and 5 November 2026, is being carried out in accordance with the Market Abuse Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 and the Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 2016/1052. Attendo shares have been repurchased as follows: +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | Date: | Aggregated daily | Weighted | Total daily | | | volume (number | average share | transaction value | | | of shares): | price per day | (SEK): | | | | (SEK): | | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | 19 October 2026 | 30,000 | 119.7422 | 3,592,265 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | 20 October 2026 | 30,000 | 118.3345 | 3,550,035 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | 21 October 2026 | 30,000 | 118.0262 | 3,540,787 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | 22 October 2026 | 30,000 | 115.4212 | 3,462,636 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | 23 October 2026 | 30,000 | 115.2551 | 3,457,652 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | Total accumulated | 150,000 | 117.3558 | 17,603,376 | | over week 43/2026 | | | | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | Total accumulated | 1,795,000 | 123.5944 | 221,851,990 | | during the program | | | | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ All acquisitions have been carried out on Nasdaq Stockholm by DNB Carnegie Investment Bank on behalf of Attendo. Following the above acquisitions, Attendo’s holding of own shares amounts to 5,305,731 shares as of 23 October 2026. The total number of shares in Attendo, including the own shares, is 144,802,487 and the number of outstanding shares, excluding the own shares, is 139,496,756. A full breakdown of the transactions is attached to this announcement. Attendo AB (publ) For more information Mikael Malmgren Chief Financial Officer Phone: +46 8 586 252 00 Email: mikael.malmgren@attendo.com About Attendo Attendo is the leading care provider in the Nordics. With compassion, commitment and competence, we create quality in every interaction and strengthen the individual in their everyday life. Through experience, specialist competence and ability to add capacity, we are part of the solution to the care challenges in society. Our vision is to provide better care to more people. The operations comprise approximately 770 units and around 33,000 employees in Finland, Sweden and Denmark. Attendo’s head quarter is located in Stockholm and the company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. events.title: Återköp av aktier under vecka 43, 2026

decisions.thesis: Attendo har stabil kapacitetsutbyggnad (nya boenden i Finland/LSS) och pågående återköp; momentum intakt trots marknadsdipp.
decisions.falsifier: Kursen stänger >20 % under 115,27 SEK eller Q3-rapporten visar fallande justerad EBITA y/y.
decisions.reason: Följer modellen; inga bolagsspecifika negativa nyheter, nedgången på 1 v (-6 %) följer marknaden.

decisions.thesis: AddTech ingår i modellens momentumurval (rang 7), och inget bolagsspecifikt talar emot.
decisions.falsifier: Modellen säljer på DD20 eller vid panelen 2026-10-29, eller kursen faller mer än 20 % från 118,38.
decisions.reason: Följer modellens vikt. Det kostar ingen affär, och underlaget ger inget skäl att avvika.

decisions.thesis: Attendo har stabil vinsttillväxt och köper tillbaka aktier varje vecka; modellen rankade bolaget 7.
decisions.falsifier: Kursen faller under 105 kr (-11 %) inom 60 dagar.
decisions.reason: Skuggans aktiedel höjs mot modellens nivå (95 % i aktier); vikten sätts lika med modellens.

decisions.thesis: Attendo växer stabilt med nya boenden (Karleby, PM 2026-10-28) och återköp; modellen rankade bolaget 7.
decisions.falsifier: Kursen faller under 105 kr inom 60 dagar.
decisions.reason: Målet ligger kvar på modellens vikt; dagens PM är rutin och motiverar ingen affär.
